name: El Camino Health Junior Auxiliary
city: Mountain View and Los Gatos, CA
what_you_do: In Mountain View you help as an escort or at the front desk. In Los Gatos you can also help nurses or rehab staff with simple tasks. You might restock linens or play board games with patients.
who_can_apply: Age 14 or older and done with 8th grade. One-year minimum. No summer internships or programs shorter than one year. Selection starts with an annual application seminar.
pay_detail: Unpaid volunteer program; no cost stated on the page
deadline_text: No application deadline posted. The page says to check back in mid-January 2027 for signup for the next Junior Application Seminar.
how_to_apply: Go to the yearly sign up meeting first. Then apply. The steps are on the El Camino Health junior volunteer page.
notes: Read again on 2026-10-16. There is no summer only option. Once you are in, you can stay through the summer after you graduate. Call Mountain View at 650-940-7214 or Los Gatos at 408-866-3940. Check the page in mid January 2027 to sign up for the next junior meeting.
